description: Defines the FillFormat class for managing shape background fill properties in MigraDoc, including color and visibility, with serialization support.

classes.name: FillFormat
classes.description: Represents the background fill of a shape, including color and visibility, with cloning and serialization capabilities.

classes.name: FillFormat.FillFormatValues
classes.description: Holds nullable internal values for FillFormat properties, such as Color and Visible.

methods.description: Serializes the FillFormat properties into DDL format.
